summary: 58-year-old woman separated from her husband on the final morning of a 3-day Missouri Lakes to Cross Creek hike; stopped to rest, got turned around and hiked in the wrong direction; Vail Mountain Rescue Group deployed six teams plus helicopter, dogs and drone; a passerby made contact about 5:00 p.m. the next day and the helicopter confirmed her location; ground crews hiked her out in good health.
location: Missouri Lakes to Cross Creek Trailhead, Holy Cross Wilderness
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group (Eagle County Sheriff's Office)
notes: INSERT run1005; ECSO media release 08.10.18: report received 9:40 a.m. Aug 8, 2018; separated on final morning of 3-day hike; located following day ~5 p.m. via passerby + helicopter; date is SAR-contact/report day per id-2146 precedent.
